--[[
    Minimal Fly Widget
    Чисто, удобно, без лишнего
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

-- Настройки
local Speed = 50
local Flying = false
local BodyVel, BodyGyro
local Conn
local Vertical = 0          -- -1 down, 0, +1 up
local Keys = {W=false, A=false, S=false, D=false, Space=false, Ctrl=false}

-- GUI Parent
local function getGuiParent()
    if gethui then
        local ok, h = pcall(gethui)
        if ok and h then return h end
    end
    return game:GetService("CoreGui")
end

local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "MinimalFly"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
ScreenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
ScreenGui.Parent = getGuiParent()

-- Основной виджет
local Widget = Instance.new("Frame")
Widget.Name = "Widget"
Widget.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(180, 210)
Widget.Position = UDim2.new(0.02, 0, 0.35, 0)
Widget.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 24)
Widget.BorderSizePixel = 0
Widget.Active = true
Widget.Draggable = true
Widget.Parent = ScreenGui

local UICorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
UICorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
UICorner.Parent = Widget

local Stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
Stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 65)
Stroke.Thickness = 1
Stroke.Parent = Widget

-- Заголовок
local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -36, 0, 32)
Title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 6)
Title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Title.Text = "FLY"
Title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 245)
Title.TextSize = 16
Title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
Title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
Title.Parent = Widget

-- Кнопка закрыть
local CloseBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
CloseBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 26)
CloseBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 6)
CloseBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 45)
CloseBtn.Text = "×"
CloseBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 210)
CloseBtn.TextSize = 18
CloseBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
CloseBtn.Parent = Widget

local CloseCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
CloseCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
CloseCorner.Parent = CloseBtn

CloseBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    ScreenGui:Destroy()
    if Flying then stopFly() end
end)

-- Скорость
local SpeedLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
SpeedLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 18)
SpeedLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 42)
SpeedLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
SpeedLabel.Text = "Speed"
SpeedLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 160)
SpeedLabel.TextSize = 12
SpeedLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
SpeedLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
SpeedLabel.Parent = Widget

local SpeedBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
SpeedBox.Size = UDim2.new(1, -90, 0, 28)
SpeedBox.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 62)
SpeedBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 38)
SpeedBox.Text = tostring(Speed)
SpeedBox.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 245)
SpeedBox.TextSize = 14
SpeedBox.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
SpeedBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false
SpeedBox.Parent = Widget

local SpeedCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
SpeedCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
SpeedCorner.Parent = SpeedBox

local function updateSpeed(val)
    Speed = math.clamp(tonumber(val) or Speed, 1, 1000)
    SpeedBox.Text = tostring(math.floor(Speed))
end

SpeedBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
    updateSpeed(SpeedBox.Text)
end)

-- Кнопки + / -
local function makeSmallBtn(text, pos)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(32, 28)
    btn.Position = pos
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 55)
    btn.Text = text
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 245)
    btn.TextSize = 16
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    btn.Parent = Widget
    local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
    c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
    c.Parent = btn
    return btn
end

local MinusBtn = makeSmallBtn("−", UDim2.new(1, -76, 0, 62))
local PlusBtn  = makeSmallBtn("+", UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 62))

MinusBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    updateSpeed(Speed - 5)
end)
PlusBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    updateSpeed(Speed + 5)
end)

-- Кнопки UP / DOWN
local function makeActionBtn(text, pos, color)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -16, 0, 34)
    btn.Position = pos
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = color or Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 55)
    btn.Text = text
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 250)
    btn.TextSize = 13
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    btn.Parent = Widget
    local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
    c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
    c.Parent = btn
    return btn
end

local UpBtn   = makeActionBtn("UP",   UDim2.fromOffset(12, 102), Color3.fromRGB(45, 55, 80))
local DownBtn = makeActionBtn("DOWN", UDim2.new(0.5, 4, 0, 102), Color3.fromRGB(45, 55, 80))

UpBtn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() Vertical = 1 end)
UpBtn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() Vertical = 0 end)
UpBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function() Vertical = 0 end)

DownBtn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() Vertical = -1 end)
DownBtn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() Vertical = 0 end)
DownBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function() Vertical = 0 end)

-- Главная кнопка FLY
local FlyBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
FlyBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 42)
FlyBtn.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 148)
FlyBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 90, 220)
FlyBtn.Text = "FLY"
FlyBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
FlyBtn.TextSize = 16
FlyBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
FlyBtn.Parent = Widget

local FlyCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
FlyCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
FlyCorner.Parent = FlyBtn

local function setFlyVisual(state)
    if state then
        FlyBtn.Text = "STOP"
        FlyBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 60, 80)
    else
        FlyBtn.Text = "FLY"
        FlyBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 90, 220)
    end
end

-- ===== Логика полёта =====
local function getRoot()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end
    return char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
end

local function stopFly()
    Flying = false
    setFlyVisual(false)
    if Conn then Conn:Disconnect() Conn = nil end
    if BodyVel then BodyVel:Destroy() BodyVel = nil end
    if BodyGyro then BodyGyro:Destroy() BodyGyro = nil end
    local hum = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum then
        hum.PlatformStand = false
    end
end

local function startFly()
    local root = getRoot()
    local hum = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not root or not hum then return end

    Flying = true
    setFlyVisual(true)

    BodyVel = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    BodyVel.MaxForce = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
    BodyVel.Velocity = Vector3.zero
    BodyVel.Parent = root

    BodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
    BodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
    BodyGyro.P = 9e4
    BodyGyro.Parent = root

    hum.PlatformStand = true

    Conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not Flying or not root or not root.Parent then
            stopFly()
            return
        end

        local camCF = Camera.CFrame
        local move = Vector3.zero

        if Keys.W then move = move + camCF.LookVector end
        if Keys.S then move = move - camCF.LookVector end
        if Keys.A then move = move - camCF.RightVector end
        if Keys.D then move = move + camCF.RightVector end

        -- вертикаль от кнопок + клавиш
        local up = Vertical
        if Keys.Space then up = up + 1 end
        if Keys.Ctrl  then up = up - 1 end

        if move.Magnitude > 0 then
            move = move.Unit * Speed
        end
        move = move + Vector3.new(0, up * Speed, 0)

        BodyVel.Velocity = move
        BodyGyro.CFrame = camCF
    end)
end

local function toggleFly()
    if Flying then
        stopFly()
    else
        startFly()
    end
end

FlyBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleFly)

-- Клавиши
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
    if gp then return end
    local key = input.KeyCode
    if key == Enum.KeyCode.W then Keys.W = true end
    if key == Enum.KeyCode.A then Keys.A = true end
    if key == Enum.KeyCode.S then Keys.S = true end
    if key == Enum.KeyCode.D then Keys.D = true end
    if key == Enum.KeyCode.Space then Keys.Space = true end
    if key == Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl or key == Enum.KeyCode.RightControl then Keys.Ctrl = true end
    if key == Enum.KeyCode.F then toggleFly() end   -- быстрый тогл на F
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    local key = input.KeyCode
    if key == Enum.KeyCode.W then Keys.W = false end
    if key == Enum.KeyCode.A then Keys.A = false end
    if key == Enum.KeyCode.S then Keys.S = false end
    if key == Enum.KeyCode.D then Keys.D = false end
    if key == Enum.KeyCode.Space then Keys.Space = false end
    if key == Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl or key == Enum.KeyCode.RightControl then Keys.Ctrl = false end
end)

-- При респавне выключаем
LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    if Flying then stopFly() end
end)

print("[Minimal Fly] loaded • F = toggle")

local function runDummyScript(f, scri)
	local oldenv = getfenv(f)

			if k:lower() == 'script' then return scri else return oldenv[k] end
		end
	})
	setfenv(f, newenv)
	ypcall(function() f() end)
end

		local SHOT_SPEED = 180

		local EXPLOSION_RADIUS = 12
		local EXPLOSION_SOUND_ID = "rbxassetid://12221984"

		local ROCKET_FORWARD_OFFSET = 1.5
		local MAX_CLICK_RANGE = 500

		local ROCKET_MESH_ID = "rbxassetid://2251534"
		local ROCKET_MESH_SCALE = Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
		local ROCKET_COLOR = "Medium stone grey"

		local ROCKET_INITIAL_ARC   = 0.45
		local ROCKET_STEER_P       = 2500
		local ROCKET_STEER_D       = 250
		local ROCKET_DETONATE_DIST = 3.0
		local ROCKET_ARC_MIN_DIST  = 25
		local ROCKET_ARC_FULL_DIST = 90
		local ROCKET_ARM_TIME      = 0.15

		local ROCKET_SLOWDOWN_DIST = 25
		local ROCKET_MIN_SPEED_FRACTION = 0.35
		local ROCKET_CORNER_MIN_SPEED = 0.35

		local WHOOSH_START_VOLUME = 2
		local WHOOSH_FADE_START   = 15
		local WHOOSH_FADE_END     = 220

		-- === OBSTACLE AVOIDANCE ===
		local ROCKET_OBSTACLE_LOOKAHEAD   = 100
		local ROCKET_OBSTACLE_AVOID_PULL  = 3.2
		local ROCKET_AVOID_BLEND          = 0.85
		local ROCKET_AVOID_STICKY_TIME    = 0.60
		local ROCKET_AVOID_RAMP_EXP       = 0.45

		local ROCKET_MAX_LEAD_TIME = 0.75
		local ROCKET_MIN_LEAD_SPEED = 2

		local ROCKET_TERMINAL_LOCK_DIST = 30
		local ROCKET_OVERSHOOT_DIST = 12

		-- === EXPLOSION TUNING ===
		local EXPLOSION_BLAST_PRESSURE   = 0     -- Keeps explosion visual & instance active, but strips out default engine kill force
		local BLAST_KNOCKBACK_STRENGTH   = 250   
		local NPC_KNOCKBACK_STRENGTH     = 110   

		local PlayersService     = Game:GetService('Players')
		local DebrisService      = Game:GetService('Debris')
		local RunService         = Game:GetService('RunService')
		local SoundService       = Game:GetService('SoundService')
		local UserInputService   = Game:GetService('UserInputService')

		local Workspace = workspace
		local LocalPlayer = PlayersService.LocalPlayer

		local Tool = script.Parent
		local Handle = Tool:WaitForChild('Handle')
		local ReloadSound = Handle:WaitForChild('Reload')

		local Character, Humanoid, Player = nil, nil, nil
		local BaseShot = nil

		local ActiveShot     = nil
		local ActiveWhoosh   = nil
		local ActiveUpdateConn = nil

		local function cleanupActive()
			if ActiveUpdateConn then
				ActiveUpdateConn:Disconnect()
				ActiveUpdateConn = nil
			end
			if ActiveWhoosh then
				ActiveWhoosh:Stop()
				ActiveWhoosh:Destroy()
				ActiveWhoosh = nil
			end
			if ActiveShot then
				ActiveShot = nil
			end
		end

		local function playAtPosition(soundId, position, volume, pitch)
			local anchor = Instance.new("Part")
			anchor.Anchored = true
			anchor.CanCollide = false
			anchor.Transparency = 1
			anchor.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
			anchor.CFrame = CFrame.new(position)
			anchor.Parent = Workspace

			local s = Instance.new("Sound")
			s.SoundId = soundId
			s.Volume = volume or 2
			s.Pitch = pitch or 1
			s.RollOffMaxDistance = 500
			s.RollOffMinDistance = 5
			s.RollOffMode = Enum.RollOffMode.InverseTapered
			s.Parent = anchor

			s:Play()
			DebrisService:AddItem(anchor, 5)
		end

		local function WeOwnCharacter(character)
			if not character or not character.Parent then return false end
			local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				or character.PrimaryPart
			if not root then return false end
			local owner = nil
			pcall(function() owner = root:GetNetworkOwner() end)
			return owner == LocalPlayer
		end

		local function TryTakeOwnership(character)
			if not character or not character.Parent then return false end
			local gotAny = false
			for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
				if part:IsA("BasePart") then
					local ok = pcall(function()
						part:SetNetworkOwner(LocalPlayer)
					end)
					if ok then gotAny = true end
				end
			end
			return gotAny
		end

		local function ApplyDamageStack(humanoid, damage)
			if not humanoid or not humanoid.Parent then return end
			if damage and damage > 0 then
				pcall(function() humanoid:TakeDamage(damage) end)
			end
			if not damage then
				pcall(function() humanoid.Health = -1 end)
				pcall(function() humanoid:TakeDamage(9999999999) end)
			elseif humanoid.Health > 0 and damage >= 9999999 then
				pcall(function() humanoid.Health = -1 end)
				pcall(function() humanoid:TakeDamage(9999999999) end)
			end
		end

		local function ReliableKill(character, humanoid)
			task.spawn(function()
				ApplyDamageStack(humanoid)

				if humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end

				for _ = 1, 20 do
					if not character.Parent or not humanoid.Parent then return end
					if humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end

					if not WeOwnCharacter(character) then
						TryTakeOwnership(character)
					end
					ApplyDamageStack(humanoid)
					task.wait(0.1)
				end
			end)
		end

		local EXPLOSION_DAMAGE_BANDS = {
			{0.50, 9999999},
			{0.58, 0.90},
			{0.67, 0.70},
			{0.75, 0.50},
			{0.83, 0.35},
			{0.92, 0.20},
			{1.00, 0.10},
		}

		local function damageFractionForRatio(ratio)
			for _, band in ipairs(EXPLOSION_DAMAGE_BANDS) do
				if ratio <= band[1] then
					return band[2]
				end
			end
			return 0
		end

		local function isPlayerCharacter(char)
			if not char then return false end
			local ok, plr = pcall(function()
				return PlayersService:GetPlayerFromCharacter(char)
			end)
			return ok and plr ~= nil
		end

		local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
		overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		overlapParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {}

		local function applyExplosion(pos)
			local radius   = EXPLOSION_RADIUS
			local propKb   = BLAST_KNOCKBACK_STRENGTH
			local npcKb    = NPC_KNOCKBACK_STRENGTH

			local parts = Workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(pos, radius, overlapParams)
			local seenChars = {}

			for _, part in ipairs(parts) do
				local char = nil
				local node = part
				for _ = 1, 4 do
					if not node or node == Workspace then break end
					node = node.Parent
					if node and node:IsA("Model")
						and node:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
						char = node
						break
					end
				end

				if char then
					if not seenChars[char] then
						seenChars[char] = true

						local hum  = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
						local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

						if hum and root and hum.Health > 0
							and char ~= Character
							and not isPlayerCharacter(char) then

							local d = (root.Position - pos).Magnitude
							if d <= radius then

								if not root.Anchored then
									local delta = root.Position - pos
									local dir
									if delta.Magnitude < 0.01 then
										dir = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
									else
										dir = delta.Unit
									end
									dir = (dir + Vector3.new(0, 0.55, 0)).Unit

									local falloff = 1 - (d / radius)
									local mass = root:GetMass()
									local impulse = dir * (npcKb * falloff) * mass

									pcall(function()
										root:ApplyImpulse(impulse)
									end)
								end

								local frac = damageFractionForRatio(d / radius)

								if frac > 1 then
									ReliableKill(char, hum)
								else
									local damage =
										(hum.MaxHealth > 0 and hum.MaxHealth or 100) * frac

									task.spawn(function()
										if not WeOwnCharacter(char) then
											for _ = 1, 5 do
												if not char.Parent or not hum.Parent
													or hum.Health <= 0 then return end
												TryTakeOwnership(char)
												if WeOwnCharacter(char) then break end
												task.wait(0.05)
											end
										end

										if not char.Parent or not hum.Parent then return end
										if hum.Health <= 0 then return end

										ApplyDamageStack(hum, damage)
									end)
								end
							end
						end
					end
				elseif part:IsA("BasePart") and not part.Anchored then
					local delta = part.Position - pos
					local d = delta.Magnitude
					if d <= radius and d > 0.01 then
						local falloff = 1 - (d / radius)
						local mass = part:GetMass()
						local impulse = delta.Unit * (propKb * falloff) * mass
						pcall(function() part:ApplyImpulse(impulse) end)
					end
				end
			end
		end

		local function killSounds(part)
			if not part then return end
			for _, child in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
				if child:IsA("Sound") then
					child.Looped = false
					child:Stop()
					child:Destroy()
				end
			end
		end

		local shotTargets = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})

		local function OnTouched(shot, otherPart, detonatePosition)
			if not shot or not shot.Parent then return end
			if shot:GetAttribute("Hit") then return end

			if otherPart then
				if not shot:GetAttribute("Armed") then
					local tgt = shotTargets[shot]
					if not (tgt and otherPart:IsDescendantOf(tgt)) then
						return
					end
				end
				local allowSelf = shot:GetAttribute("AllowSelfHit") == true
				if (not allowSelf) and Character and otherPart:IsDescendantOf(Character) then
					return
				end
			end

			shot:SetAttribute("Hit", true)

			local pos = detonatePosition or shot.Position

			cleanupActive()
			killSounds(shot)
			shot:Destroy()

			-- Spawns the standard visual explosion object, but with 0 blast pressure so your custom damage bands handle the kills safely
			local explosion = Instance.new("Explosion")
			explosion.BlastRadius = EXPLOSION_RADIUS
			explosion.BlastPressure = EXPLOSION_BLAST_PRESSURE
			explosion.DestroyJointRadiusPercent = 0
			explosion.Position = pos
			explosion.Parent = Workspace

			applyExplosion(pos)

			playAtPosition(EXPLOSION_SOUND_ID, pos, 2.5, 1)
		end

		local function OnEquipped()
			Character = Tool.Parent
			Humanoid = Character:WaitForChild('Humanoid')
			Player = PlayersService:GetPlayerFromCharacter(Character)
		end

		local function nozzleCFrame(position, forward)
			forward = forward.Magnitude > 1e-4 and forward.Unit or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)

			local upRef = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
			if math.abs(forward:Dot(upRef)) > 0.99 then
				upRef = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
			end

			local vZ = -forward
			local vY = (upRef - vZ * vZ:Dot(upRef)).Unit
			local vX = vY:Cross(vZ)
			return CFrame.fromMatrix(position, vX, vY, vZ)
		end

		local function closestPointOnSegment(A, B, P)
			local ab = B - A
			local abLen2 = ab:Dot(ab)
			if abLen2 < 1e-6 then
				return (P - A).Magnitude, A
			end
			local t = (P - A):Dot(ab) / abLen2
			t = math.clamp(t, 0, 1)
			local closest = A + ab * t
			return (P - closest).Magnitude, closest
		end

		local function findClickTarget()
			local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
			if not camera then
				return { staticPosition = Humanoid and Humanoid.TargetPoint or Vector3.new() }
			end

			local mouseLocation = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
			local ray = camera:ViewportPointToRay(mouseLocation.X, mouseLocation.Y)

			local params = RaycastParams.new()
			params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
			local excludeList = {}
			if Handle then table.insert(excludeList, Handle) end
			if ActiveShot then table.insert(excludeList, ActiveShot) end
			params.FilterDescendantsInstances = excludeList

			local result = Workspace:Raycast(ray.Origin, ray.Direction * MAX_CLICK_RANGE, params)

			if not result then
				local fallback = Humanoid and Humanoid.TargetPoint or (ray.Origin + ray.Direction * 100)
				return { staticPosition = fallback }
			end

			local hitPart = result.Instance

			local currentModel = hitPart:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
			while currentModel do
				local modelHumanoid = currentModel:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				local rootPart = currentModel:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					or (modelHumanoid and modelHumanoid.RootPart)
					or (modelHumanoid and modelHumanoid.Torso)

				if modelHumanoid or rootPart then
					return {
						npc            = currentModel,
						humanoid       = modelHumanoid,
						rootPart       = rootPart or hitPart,
						hitPosition    = result.Position,
						staticPosition = result.Position,
					}
				end

				currentModel = currentModel:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
			end

			return {
				staticPosition = result.Position,
				hitPart        = hitPart,
			}
		end

		local function shouldDodgeObstacle(hitPart)
			local node = hitPart
			local topModel = nil
			for _ = 1, 6 do
				if not node or node == Workspace then break end
				if node:IsA("Model") then
					if node:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
						return false
					end
					topModel = node
				end
				node = node.Parent
			end

			local size
			if topModel then
				local ok, bbox = pcall(function()
					return topModel:GetExtentsSize()
				end)
				if ok and bbox then
					size = bbox
				end
			end
			if not size then
				size = hitPart.Size
			end

			local axes = {size.X, size.Y, size.Z}
			table.sort(axes)
			if axes[1] < 3 and axes[2] < 3 then
				return false
			end

			return true
		end

		local function findAvoidanceDir(origin, desiredDir, params, maxLen)
			local lookLen = math.min(ROCKET_OBSTACLE_LOOKAHEAD, maxLen or ROCKET_OBSTACLE_LOOKAHEAD)

			local hit = Workspace:Raycast(origin, desiredDir * lookLen, params)
			if not hit then return nil, 0 end

			if not shouldDodgeObstacle(hit.Instance) then
				return nil, 0
			end

			local hitDist = (hit.Position - origin).Magnitude
			local strength = math.clamp(1 - (hitDist / lookLen), 0, 1)
			strength = strength ^ ROCKET_AVOID_RAMP_EXP

			local up = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
			if math.abs(desiredDir:Dot(up)) > 0.95 then
				up = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
			end
			local right = desiredDir:Cross(up).Unit
			local left = -right
			local down = -up

			local candidates = {
				right, left,
				(right + up).Unit,   (left + up).Unit,
				(right + down).Unit, (left + down).Unit,
				up, down,
			}
			local bestDir, bestScore = nil, -math.huge

			for _, side in ipairs(candidates) do
				local candidate = (desiredDir + side * ROCKET_OBSTACLE_AVOID_PULL).Unit
				local test = Workspace:Raycast(origin, candidate * lookLen, params)
				local clearance
				if test then
					clearance = (test.Position - origin).Magnitude
				else
					clearance = lookLen
				end
				local score = clearance + candidate:Dot(desiredDir) * 6
				if candidate.Y < -0.3 then
					score = score - 8
				end
				if score > bestScore then
					bestScore, bestDir = score, candidate
				end
			end

			return bestDir, strength
		end

		local function OnActivated()
			if Tool.Enabled and Humanoid.Health > 0 then
				Tool.Enabled = false

				cleanupActive()

				local handleCFrame = Handle.CFrame
				local firingPoint = handleCFrame:PointToWorldSpace(MUZZLE_LOCAL_OFFSET)

				local clickTarget = findClickTarget()

				local initialTargetPos
				if clickTarget.npc and clickTarget.rootPart and clickTarget.rootPart.Parent then
					initialTargetPos = clickTarget.rootPart.Position
				else
					initialTargetPos = clickTarget.staticPosition
				end

				local aimVec = initialTargetPos - firingPoint
				if aimVec.Magnitude < 1e-3 then
					aimVec = handleCFrame.lookVector * 100
					initialTargetPos = firingPoint + aimVec
				end

				local targetDistance = (initialTargetPos - firingPoint).Magnitude

				local arcAmount = 0
				if targetDistance > ROCKET_ARC_MIN_DIST then
					local t = math.clamp(
						(targetDistance - ROCKET_ARC_MIN_DIST) /
						(ROCKET_ARC_FULL_DIST - ROCKET_ARC_MIN_DIST),
						0, 1)
					arcAmount = ROCKET_INITIAL_ARC * t
				end

				local initialForward = (aimVec.Unit + Vector3.new(0, arcAmount, 0)).Unit

				local shot = BaseShot:Clone()
				local initialCF = nozzleCFrame(firingPoint + initialForward * ROCKET_FORWARD_OFFSET, initialForward)
				shot.CFrame = initialCF
				ActiveShot = shot

				if clickTarget.npc then
					shotTargets[shot] = clickTarget.npc
				end
				task.delay(ROCKET_ARM_TIME, function()
					if shot and shot.Parent then
						shot:SetAttribute("Armed", true)
					end
				end)

				local isSelfTarget = (clickTarget.npc ~= nil and clickTarget.npc == Character)
				if isSelfTarget then
					shot:SetAttribute("AllowSelfHit", true)
				end

				local targetPart = nil
				if clickTarget.npc and clickTarget.rootPart and clickTarget.rootPart.Parent then
					targetPart = clickTarget.rootPart
				end

				local whoosh = Instance.new("Sound")
				whoosh.Name = "RocketWhoosh"
				whoosh.SoundId = "rbxasset://sounds/Rocket whoosh 01.wav"
				whoosh.Looped = true
				whoosh.Volume = WHOOSH_START_VOLUME
				whoosh.Parent = SoundService
				ActiveWhoosh = whoosh

				local gyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
				gyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
				gyro.P = ROCKET_STEER_P
				gyro.D = ROCKET_STEER_D
				gyro.CFrame = initialCF
				gyro.Parent = shot

				local bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
				bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
				bodyVelocity.Velocity = initialForward * SHOT_SPEED
				bodyVelocity.Parent = shot

				local lastPos = shot.Position
				local committedAvoidDir, committedAvoidUntil = nil, 0
				local terminalLock = false

				local ignoreList = {shot, Handle}
				if Character then table.insert(ignoreList, Character) end
				if clickTarget.npc then table.insert(ignoreList, clickTarget.npc) end

				local avoidParams = RaycastParams.new()
				avoidParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
				avoidParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignoreList
				avoidParams.IgnoreWater = true

				local updateConn
				updateConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
					if not shot or not shot.Parent then
						if updateConn then updateConn:Disconnect() end
						return
					end

					local liveTargetPos
					if targetPart and targetPart.Parent then
						liveTargetPos = targetPart.Position
					else
						liveTargetPos = clickTarget.staticPosition
					end

					local currentPos = shot.Position
					local distToTarget = (liveTargetPos - currentPos).Magnitude

					local closestDist, closestPt = closestPointOnSegment(lastPos, currentPos, liveTargetPos)
					if closestDist <= ROCKET_DETONATE_DIST then
						OnTouched(shot, nil, closestPt)
						return
					end

					if not terminalLock and distToTarget <= ROCKET_TERMINAL_LOCK_DIST then
						terminalLock = true
					end

					if terminalLock then
						local lockVec = liveTargetPos - currentPos
						if lockVec.Magnitude > 0.01 then
							local dir = lockVec.Unit

							local forwardDot = dir:Dot(shot.CFrame.LookVector)
							if forwardDot < -0.5 and distToTarget < ROCKET_OVERSHOOT_DIST then
								OnTouched(shot, nil, currentPos)
								return
							end

							gyro.CFrame = CFrame.new(currentPos, currentPos + dir)
							bodyVelocity.Velocity = dir * SHOT_SPEED
						else
							OnTouched(shot, nil, currentPos)
							return
						end
					else
						local steerTargetPos = liveTargetPos
						local toTargetSteer = steerTargetPos - currentPos
						local finalDir = shot.CFrame.LookVector

						if toTargetSteer.Magnitude > 0.5 then
							local desiredDir = toTargetSteer.Unit
							finalDir = desiredDir

							local probeLen = math.min(
								ROCKET_OBSTACLE_LOOKAHEAD,
								math.max(0, distToTarget - 4))

							if probeLen >= 5 then
								local blend = 0

								if committedAvoidDir and os.clock() < committedAvoidUntil then
									local probe = Workspace:Raycast(
										currentPos,
										desiredDir * probeLen,
										avoidParams)
									if probe and shouldDodgeObstacle(probe.Instance) then
										local d = (probe.Position - currentPos).Magnitude
										local s = math.clamp(1 - (d / probeLen), 0, 1)
										blend = ROCKET_AVOID_BLEND * (s ^ ROCKET_AVOID_RAMP_EXP)
									elseif probe then
										committedAvoidDir = nil
										blend = 0
									else
										blend = ROCKET_AVOID_BLEND
									end
									if blend > 0 then
										finalDir = (desiredDir * (1 - blend)
											+ committedAvoidDir * blend).Unit
									end
								else
									local avoidDir, avoidStrength =
										findAvoidanceDir(currentPos, desiredDir, avoidParams, probeLen)
									if avoidDir then
										committedAvoidDir = avoidDir
										committedAvoidUntil = os.clock() + ROCKET_AVOID_STICKY_TIME
										blend = ROCKET_AVOID_BLEND * avoidStrength
										finalDir = (desiredDir * (1 - blend)
											+ avoidDir * blend).Unit
									else
										committedAvoidDir = nil
									end
								end
							else
								committedAvoidDir = nil
							end

							gyro.CFrame = CFrame.new(currentPos, currentPos + finalDir)
						end

						local speed = SHOT_SPEED
						if distToTarget < ROCKET_SLOWDOWN_DIST then
							local t = distToTarget / ROCKET_SLOWDOWN_DIST
							speed = SHOT_SPEED * math.max(ROCKET_MIN_SPEED_FRACTION, t)
						end

						local curForward = shot.CFrame.LookVector
						local alignment = math.clamp(curForward:Dot(finalDir), 0, 1)
						local cornerFactor = ROCKET_CORNER_MIN_SPEED
							+ (1 - ROCKET_CORNER_MIN_SPEED) * alignment
						speed = speed * cornerFactor

						bodyVelocity.Velocity = curForward * speed
					end

					lastPos = currentPos

					if whoosh and whoosh.Parent then
						local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
						if cam then
							local dist = (currentPos - cam.CFrame.Position).Magnitude
							local alpha
							if dist <= WHOOSH_FADE_START then
								alpha = 1
							elseif dist >= WHOOSH_FADE_END then
								alpha = 0
							else
								alpha = 1 - ((dist - WHOOSH_FADE_START) / (WHOOSH_FADE_END - WHOOSH_FADE_START))
							end
							whoosh.Volume = WHOOSH_START_VOLUME * alpha
							if alpha <= 0 then
								whoosh:Stop()
							end
						end
					end
				end)
				ActiveUpdateConn = updateConn

				shot.Destroying:Connect(function()
					if updateConn then updateConn:Disconnect() end
					if ActiveUpdateConn == updateConn then ActiveUpdateConn = nil end
					if whoosh then
						whoosh:Stop()
						whoosh:Destroy()
						if ActiveWhoosh == whoosh then ActiveWhoosh = nil end
					end
				end)

				whoosh:Play()

				shot.Touched:Connect(function(otherPart)
					OnTouched(shot, otherPart)
				end)
				DebrisService:AddItem(shot, SHOT_TIME)
				shot.Parent = Tool

				task.delay(SHOT_TIME + 0.1, function()
					if ActiveShot == shot then
						cleanupActive()
					end
				end)

				wait(0)
				ReloadSound:Play()
				wait(2)
				Tool.Enabled = true
			end
		end

		BaseShot = Instance.new('Part')
		BaseShot.Name = 'Rocket'
		BaseShot.FormFactor = Enum.FormFactor.Custom
		BaseShot.Shape = Enum.PartType.Block
		BaseShot.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
		BaseShot.CanCollide = false
		BaseShot.BrickColor = BrickColor.new(ROCKET_COLOR)
		BaseShot.Material = Enum.Material.Plastic
		BaseShot.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
		BaseShot.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth

		local rocketMesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
		rocketMesh.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.FileMesh
		rocketMesh.MeshId = ROCKET_MESH_ID
		rocketMesh.Scale = ROCKET_MESH_SCALE
		rocketMesh.Parent = BaseShot

		local rocketFire = Instance.new("Fire")
		rocketFire.Heat = ROCKET_FIRE_HEAT
		rocketFire.Size = ROCKET_FIRE_SIZE
		rocketFire.Parent = BaseShot

		Tool.Equipped:Connect(OnEquipped)
		Tool.Activated:Connect(OnActivated)
	end, ToolScript)
end))

	if #tabs <= 1 then return end
	local idx
	for i, t in ipairs(tabs) do if t == tab then idx = i break end end
	if not idx then return end
	tab.frame:Destroy()
	tab.textBox:Destroy()
	table.remove(tabs, idx)
	if currentTab == tab then switchToTab(tabs[math.min(idx, #tabs)]) end
end

local function createTab()
	if #tabs >= MAX_TABS then return end
	local num = getNextTabNumber()
	if not num then return end
	local tab = { number = num }

	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")

	textBox.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
	textBox.Visible = false
	tab.textBox = textBox

	textBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
		if currentTab == tab then updateLineNumbers(textBox) end
	end)

	label.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() switchToTab(tab) end)
	table.insert(tabs, tab)
	switchToTab(tab)
	return tab
end

local function runCode(code)
	if not code or code == "" or code:match("^%s*$") then return end
	local chunk, err = loadstring(code)

local function executeFling()
	if not selectedTarget or not selectedTarget.Character or not selectedTarget.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
		return
	end

	local char = LocalPlayer.Character
	if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end

	local hrp = char.HumanoidRootPart
	local targetHrp = selectedTarget.Character.HumanoidRootPart

	local oldCFrame = hrp.CFrame
	local startTime = tick()

	local BodyAngularVelocity = Instance.new("BodyAngularVelocity")
	BodyAngularVelocity.AngularVelocity = Vector3.new(99999, 99999, 99999)
	BodyAngularVelocity.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
	BodyAngularVelocity.P = 125000
	BodyAngularVelocity.Parent = hrp

	local renderConn
	renderConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if tick() - startTime < 2 and selectedTarget and selectedTarget.Character and selectedTarget.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
			hrp.CFrame = targetHrp.CFrame
		else
			renderConn:Disconnect()
			BodyAngularVelocity:Destroy()
			hrp.CFrame = oldCFrame
		end
	end)
end

	local isSeated = hum and hum.Sit

	if isSeated or hasNoCollision then
		showNotificationModal("O alvo não tem colisão ou está sentado, deseja executar o arremesso mesmo assim?", function()

		end)
	else

	end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local VoiceChatService = game:GetService("VoiceChatService")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

-- System Configuration
local MAX_HOTBAR = 5 
local clickThreshold = 15 
local SLOT_SIZE = 48 
local SLOT_PADDING = 10 
local INV_SLOT_SIZE = 50 

-- Tool Tracking State
local hotbarList = {}
local inventoryList = {}
local currentSearchText = ""

local canMoveIcons = false
local canMoveHotbar = false

-- 1. Disable the default Roblox backpack UI
pcall(function() StarterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.Backpack, false) end)

-- 2. Create the ScreenGui Container

screenGui.Name = "DeltaInventorySystem"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true 
screenGui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Forward declaration for UI update & Revert function
local renderUI
local function revertToDefault()
    pcall(function() StarterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.Backpack, true) end)
    if screenGui then
        screenGui:Destroy()
    end
end

-- 3. Topbar Container & Icons
local baseOffsetX = 105 
local isVoiceEnabled = false
pcall(function() isVoiceEnabled = VoiceChatService:IsVoiceEnabledForUserIdAsync(player.UserId) end)
if isVoiceEnabled then baseOffsetX = baseOffsetX + 45 end

local topbarContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
topbarContainer.Name = "TopbarContainer"
topbarContainer.Size = UDim2.new(0, 85, 0, 36)
topbarContainer.Position = UDim2.new(0, baseOffsetX, 0, 4)
topbarContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
topbarContainer.Parent = screenGui

local toggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
toggleBtn.Name = "InventoryToggle"
toggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 36, 0, 36)
toggleBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
toggleBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
toggleBtn.Text = "🎒"
toggleBtn.TextScaled = true
toggleBtn.Parent = topbarContainer
Instance.new("UICorner", toggleBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

local settingsBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
settingsBtn.Name = "SettingsToggle"
settingsBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 36, 0, 36)
settingsBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 45, 0, 0)
settingsBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
settingsBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2

    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150)

    stroke.Parent = gui
end
addStroke(toggleBtn)

-- 4. Dragging Helper Logic
local function makeDraggable(frame, triggerObjects, conditionFunc)
    local dragging, dragStart, startPos
    for _, obj in ipairs(triggerObjects) do
        obj.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if conditionFunc() and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
                dragging = true
                dragStart = input.Position
                startPos = frame.Position
            end
        end)
    end
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            local delta = input.Position - dragStart
            frame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
        end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = false
        end
    end)
end

    frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    frame.Parent = settingsPanel
    
    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.Size = UDim2.new(0.7, 0, 1, 0)
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.Text = text
    label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
    label.Font = Enum.Font.Code
    label.TextSize = 14
    label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    label.Parent = frame
    
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")

    local state = false

    frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    frame.Parent = settingsPanel
    
    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")

    label.Text = labelName

    local minusBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")

    local valLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")

    valLabel.Text = tostring(getVal())
    valLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    valLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Code
    valLabel.TextSize = 14
    valLabel.Parent = frame

    local plusBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    plusBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.12, 0, 0.8, 0)
    plusBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.87, 0, 0.1, 0)
    plusBtn.Text = "+"
    plusBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
    plusBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    plusBtn.Parent = frame
    Instance.new("UICorner", plusBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)

    minusBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        local current = getVal()
        if current > minVal then
            setVal(current - 1)

            valLabel.Text = tostring(getVal())
            if renderUI then renderUI() end
        end
    end)
end

    tool.Parent = workspace

        local character = player.Character
        local hrp = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if hrp then
            task.wait()
            handle.AssemblyLinearVelocity = (hrp.CFrame.LookVector * 15) + Vector3.new(0, 10, 0)

    end

    for tool in pairs(currentTools) do
        if not table.find(hotbarList, tool) and not table.find(inventoryList, tool) then
            if #hotbarList < MAX_HOTBAR then

end

    for _, child in ipairs(hotbarFrame:GetChildren()) do if child:IsA("TextButton") then child:Destroy() end end

    hotbarFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, hotbarWidth, 0, SLOT_SIZE + 10)

        stroke.Parent = btn

        if parentFrame == hotbarFrame then
            btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, SLOT_SIZE, 0, SLOT_SIZE)
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
            btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.4
            stroke.Thickness = 1
            if tool.Parent == character then
                btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 80)
                stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220)
            else
                stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 100)
            end
        else
            btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, INV_SLOT_SIZE, 0, INV_SLOT_SIZE)
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
            btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
            stroke.Thickness = 1.2
            if tool.Parent == character then
                stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220)
                btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 80)
            else
                stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 100)
            end
        end

        local dragging = false
        local dragInput, dragStart, ghostBtn
        local lastClickTick = 0

        btn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if not dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
                dragging = true
                dragInput = input
                dragStart = input.Position
            end
        end)

        UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if dragging and input == dragInput then
                local delta = input.Position - dragStart
                if delta.Magnitude >= clickThreshold then
                    if not ghostBtn then
                        ghostBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
                        ghostBtn.Size = btn.Size
                        ghostBtn.Text = tool.Name
                        ghostBtn.TextScaled = true
                        ghostBtn.Font = Enum.Font.Code
                        ghostBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 80)
                        ghostBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
                        ghostBtn.ZIndex = 10
                        ghostBtn.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
                        Instance.new("UICorner", ghostBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
                        ghostBtn.Parent = screenGui
                        
                        btn.TextTransparency = 0.8
                        btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.8
                    end
                    ghostBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, input.Position.X, 0, input.Position.Y)
                end
            end
        end)

        UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if dragging and input == dragInput then
                dragging = false
                local delta = input.Position - dragStart

                if ghostBtn then
                    local dropPos = input.Position
                    ghostBtn:Destroy()
                    ghostBtn = nil

                    if isInside(dropPos, dropBox) then
                        local invIdx = table.find(inventoryList, tool)
                        if invIdx then table.remove(inventoryList, invIdx) end
                        local hotIdx = table.find(hotbarList, tool)
                        if hotIdx then table.remove(hotbarList, hotIdx) end
                        triggerDrop(tool)
                    elseif isInside(dropPos, hotbarFrame) then
                        if not table.find(hotbarList, tool) then
                            local invIdx = table.find(inventoryList, tool)
                            if invIdx then table.remove(inventoryList, invIdx) end
                            
                            if #hotbarList >= MAX_HOTBAR then
                                table.insert(inventoryList, table.remove(hotbarList, 1))
                            end
                            table.insert(hotbarList, tool)
                        end
                    elseif isInside(dropPos, invContainer) then
                        if not table.find(inventoryList, tool) then
                            local hotIdx = table.find(hotbarList, tool)
                            if hotIdx then table.remove(hotbarList, hotIdx) end
                            table.insert(inventoryList, tool)
                        end
                    end
                    renderUI() 
                else
                    if delta.Magnitude < clickThreshold then
                        if parentFrame == invScroll then
                            local currentTick = tick()
                            if currentTick - lastClickTick < 0.35 then
                                if #hotbarList < MAX_HOTBAR then
                                    local invIdx = table.find(inventoryList, tool)
                                    if invIdx then
                                        table.remove(inventoryList, invIdx)
                                        table.insert(hotbarList, tool)
                                        renderUI()
                                    end
                                end
                                lastClickTick = 0
                            else
                                lastClickTick = currentTick
                            end
                        else
                            if tool.Parent == character then humanoid:UnequipTools()
                            else humanoid:EquipTool(tool) end
                            renderUI()
                        end
                    end
                end
                dragInput = nil
            end
        end)
    end

    for _, tool in ipairs(hotbarList) do createSlot(tool, hotbarFrame) end
    for _, tool in ipairs(inventoryList) do 
        if currentSearchText == "" or string.find(string.lower(tool.Name), currentSearchText, 1, true) then
            createSlot(tool, invScroll) 
        end
    end
end

    syncTools()
    renderUI()
end

scripts.title: Anti-Bang (BEST) open-source
scripts.features: For those infinite yield skids that bangs you
scripts.script:
if _G.AntiBang_Shutdown then
    pcall(_G.AntiBang_Shutdown)
    _G.AntiBang_Shutdown = nil
end

local Players          = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService       = game:GetService("RunService")
local StarterGui       = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

-- {{ toggle }}

local CONFIG = {
    ENABLED = true, -- turn anti off or on (use true or false)
}

local NOTIFY = true -- notify if it succeeded (use true or false)

local function getTorso(char)
    if not char then return nil end
    return char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
        or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
        or char:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso")
        or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function getRoot(char)
    if not char then return nil end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    return (hum and hum.RootPart) or char.PrimaryPart
end

local function notify(title, text)
    if not NOTIFY then return end
    pcall(function()
        StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
            Title = title, Text = text, Duration = 3
        })
    end)
end

local function matchesBangFingerprint(plr, myTorso)
    local theirChar = plr.Character
    if not theirChar then return false end

    local theirHRP = theirChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not theirHRP then return false end

    local localOffset = myTorso.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(theirHRP.Position)

    if math.abs(localOffset.X) > 0.25 then return false end
    if math.abs(localOffset.Y) > 0.25 then return false end
    if math.abs(localOffset.Z - 1.1) > 0.25 then return false end

    local dot = theirHRP.CFrame.LookVector:Dot(myTorso.CFrame.LookVector)
    if dot < 0.995 then return false end

    return true
end

local dipBusy = false
local function voidDip()
    if dipBusy then return end
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not myChar then return end
    local root = getRoot(myChar)
    if not root or not root.Parent then return end

    dipBusy = true
    local savedCF = root.CFrame
    local savedDH = workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight

    workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = -1e9

    local t0 = tick()
    pcall(function()
        while tick() - t0 < 0.15 do
            if not root.Parent then break end
            root.CFrame                  = CFrame.new(0, -800, 0)
            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity  = Vector3.zero
            root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
            task.wait()
        end
    end)

    if root.Parent then
        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity  = Vector3.zero
        root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        root.CFrame                  = savedCF
        local hum = myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp) end
    end

    task.wait()
    workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = savedDH
    dipBusy = false
end

local confirmCount = {}
local lastAction   = 0

local steppedConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
    if not CONFIG.ENABLED then return end
    if dipBusy then return end

    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not myChar then return end
    local myTorso = getTorso(myChar)
    if not myTorso then return end

    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr.Character then
            if matchesBangFingerprint(plr, myTorso) then
                confirmCount[plr] = (confirmCount[plr] or 0) + 1

                if confirmCount[plr] >= 5 then
                    confirmCount[plr] = 0

                    if tick() - lastAction < 1.5 then
                        return
                    end
                    lastAction = tick()

                    notify("Anti-Bang", "Bang confirmed from " .. plr.Name)
                    voidDip()
                    return
                end
            else
                confirmCount[plr] = 0
            end
        end
    end
end)

local inputConn = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
    if processed then return end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightControl then
        CONFIG.ENABLED = not CONFIG.ENABLED
        notify("Anti-Bang", CONFIG.ENABLED and "Enabled" or "Disabled")
    end
end)

local removeConn = Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr)
    confirmCount[plr] = nil
end)

local charConn = LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    confirmCount = {}
    dipBusy      = false
end)

_G.AntiBang_Shutdown = function()
    steppedConn:Disconnect()
    inputConn:Disconnect()
    removeConn:Disconnect()
    charConn:Disconnect()
end

_G.AntiBang_Toggle = function(state)
    if type(state) == "boolean" then
        CONFIG.ENABLED = state
    else
        CONFIG.ENABLED = not CONFIG.ENABLED
    end
    notify("Anti-Bang", CONFIG.ENABLED and "Enabled" or "Disabled")
end

notify("Anti-Bang", "Loaded")

		end
	end

	swatch.Activated:Connect(function()
		WHAT(not open)
	end)

	api.close = function()
		WHAT(false)
	end
	table.insert(pickers, api)
	paint()
	return api
end

local function updateLines()
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local vs = cam.ViewportSize
	local ax, ay = vs.X / 2, vs.Y
	for _, d in espData do
		local line = d.line
		if line then
			local rt = d.root
			local show = false
			if rt and rt.Parent then
				local p = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(rt.Position)
				if p.Z > 0 then
					show = true
					if d.px ~= p.X or d.py ~= p.Y then
						d.px, d.py = p.X, p.Y
						local dx, dy = p.X - ax, p.Y - ay
						line.Position = offset(ax + dx / 2, ay + dy / 2)
						line.Size = offset(2, math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy))
						line.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(dy, dx)) - 90
					end
				else
					d.px = nil
				end
			end
			if line.Visible ~= show then
				line.Visible = show
			end
		end
	end
end

local function refresh()
	if isOn then

		else

local function b64decode(s)

		local r, f = '', (b:find(x) - 1)
		for i = 6, 1, -1 do r = r .. (f % 2^i - f % 2^(i-1) > 0 and '1' or '0') end

local function getSilentRemote()
	local hd = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("HDAdminHDClient")
		or ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("HDClient")
	if not hd then return nil end
	local signals = hd:FindFirstChild("Signals")
	if not signals then return nil end
	return signals:FindFirstChild("RequestCommandSilent")
		or signals:FindFirstChild("RequestCommand")
end

local function runSilent(cmd)
	local remote = getSilentRemote()
	if not remote then warn("[HD Admin] silent remote not found") return end
	pcall(function() remote:InvokeServer(PREFIX .. cmd) end)
end

local function getF3XRemote()
	local tool
	if player.Character then
		tool = player.Character:FindFirstChild("Building Tools+")
	end
	if not tool and player:FindFirstChild("Backpack") then
		tool = player.Backpack:FindFirstChild("Building Tools+")
	end
	if not tool then
		for _, v in ipairs(player:GetDescendants()) do
			if v.Name == "SyncAPI" then tool = v.Parent break end
		end
	end
	if not tool then
		for _, v in ipairs(ReplicatedStorage:GetDescendants()) do
			if v.Name == "SyncAPI" then tool = v.Parent break end
		end
	end
	if tool then
		local api = tool:FindFirstChild("SyncAPI")
		if api then return api:FindFirstChild("ServerEndpoint") end
	end
end

local function spawnSkyboxWithID(textureID, label)
	local char = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
	local tool

	for _, v in ipairs(player:GetDescendants()) do
		if v.Name == "SyncAPI" then tool = v.Parent break end
	end
	if not tool then
		for _, v in ipairs(ReplicatedStorage:GetDescendants()) do
			if v.Name == "SyncAPI" then tool = v.Parent break end
		end
	end

	if not tool then
		warn(("[" .. label .. "] F3X not found"))
		return
	end

	local remote = tool.SyncAPI.ServerEndpoint
	local function _(args) pcall(function() remote:InvokeServer(unpack(args)) end) end

	local function CreatePart(cf, parent) _({"CreatePart", "Normal", cf, parent}) end
	local function AddMesh(part) _({"CreateMeshes", {{Part = part}}}) end
	local function SetMesh(part, meshid) _({"SyncMesh", {{Part = part, MeshId = "rbxassetid://" .. meshid}}}) end
	local function SetTexture(part, texid) _({"SyncMesh", {{Part = part, TextureId = "rbxassetid://" .. texid}}}) end
	local function MeshResize(part, size) _({"SyncMesh", {{Part = part, Scale = size}}}) end
	local function SetName(part, stringg) _({"SetName", {part}, stringg}) end
	local function SetCollision(part, boolean) _({"SyncCollision", {{Part = part, CanCollide = boolean}}}) end
	local function SetLocked(part, boolean) _({"SetLocked", {part}, boolean}) end
	local function SetAnchor(part, boolean) _({"SyncAnchor", {{Part = part}, Anchored = boolean}}) end

	local spawnCF = CFrame.new(0, 500, 0)

	CreatePart(spawnCF, workspace)
	task.wait(0.2)

	local skyPart
	local closest = math.huge
	for _, v in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
		if v:IsA("BasePart") then
			local d = (v.Position - spawnCF.Position).Magnitude
			if d < 10 and d < closest then
				closest = d
				skyPart = v
			end
		end
	end

	if not skyPart then
		warn(("[" .. label .. "] part not found"))
		return
	end

	SetName(skyPart, "Sky")
	task.wait(0.05)

	AddMesh(skyPart)
	task.wait(0.1)
	SetMesh(skyPart, "111891702759441")
	task.wait(0.1)
	SetTexture(skyPart, textureID)
	task.wait(0.1)

	MeshResize(skyPart, Vector3.new(1000, 1000, 1000))
	task.wait(0.2)

	SetCollision(skyPart, false)
	SetLocked(skyPart, true)
	SetAnchor(skyPart, true)

	local guardConn
	guardConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if not skyPart or not skyPart.Parent then
			if guardConn then guardConn:Disconnect() end
			return
		end
		if skyPart.Position.Y < 100 then
			pcall(function() skyPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, 500, 0) end)
			SetAnchor(skyPart, true)
		end
	end)
end

-- ============================================================
local function unanchorAll()
	local remote = getF3XRemote()
	if not remote then
		warn("[Unanchor All] F3X not found — click [F3X] first")
		return
	end

	local function fire(args)
		pcall(function() remote:InvokeServer(unpack(args)) end)
	end

	task.spawn(function()
		local parts = {}
		for _, v in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
			if v:IsA("BasePart") then
				parts[#parts + 1] = v
			end
		end

		local total = #parts
		print("[Unanchor All] Найдено частей:", total)
		local t0 = tick()

		if total == 0 then
			print("[Unanchor All] Нечего откреплять.")
			return
		end

		local completed = 0

		for i = 1, total do
			local part = parts[i]
			task.spawn(function()
				if part and part.Parent then
					fire({"SyncAnchor", {{Part = part}, false}})
					fire({"SetLocked", {part}, false})
				end
				completed = completed + 1
			end)
		end

		while completed < total do
			task.wait()
		end

		local elapsed = tick() - t0
		print(string.format("[Unanchor All] Карта откреплена за %.2f сек! (%d частей)", elapsed, total))
	end)
end

		pcall(function()
			serverendpoint:InvokeServer("SyncColor", {{Part = part, Color = c, UnionColoring = false}})
		end)
	end
	local function syncmeshid(part, id)
		pcall(function()
			serverendpoint:InvokeServer("SyncMesh", {{Part = part, MeshId = "rbxassetid://" .. id}})
		end)
	end
	local function makemesh(part)
		pcall(function()
			serverendpoint:InvokeServer("CreateMeshes", {{Part = part}})

	local function syncmeshsize(part, vec)
		pcall(function()
			serverendpoint:InvokeServer("SyncMesh", {{Part = part, Scale = vec}})

	local function syncmeshtexture(part, id)
		pcall(function()
			serverendpoint:InvokeServer("SyncMesh", {{Part = part, TextureId = "rbxassetid://" .. id}})
		end)
	end
	local function name(part, s)

	local function lock(part, b)
		pcall(function()
			serverendpoint:InvokeServer("SetLocked", {part}, b)

	local function setcollision(part, b)
		pcall(function()
			serverendpoint:InvokeServer("SyncCollision", {{Part = part, CanCollide = b}})

	end
	local function createdecal(part, side)
		pcall(function()
			serverendpoint:InvokeServer("CreateTextures", {{Part = part, Face = side, TextureType = "Decal"}})

			serverendpoint:InvokeServer("SyncTexture", {{Part = part, Face = side, TextureType = "Decal", Texture = "rbxassetid://" .. asset}})

scripts.script:
local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://sirius.menu/rayfield'))()

local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
   Name = "Fly Hub | Rayfield",
   LoadingTitle = "Rayfield Fly Script",
   LoadingSubtitle = "by Fly Hub",
   ConfigurationSaving = {
      Enabled = false
   },
   Discord = {
      Enabled = false
   },
   KeySystem = false
})

-- Variables
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

local flying = false
local speed = 50
local walkSpeedValue = 16
local bodyVelocity, bodyGyro

-- Fly Functions
local function startFlying()
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then return end
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not root or not humanoid then return end

	humanoid.PlatformStand = true

	bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
	bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1) * 100000
	bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.zero
	bodyVelocity.Parent = root

	bodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
	bodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1) * 100000
	bodyGyro.CFrame = root.CFrame
	bodyGyro.Parent = root

	flying = true
end

local function stopFlying()
	flying = false
	if bodyVelocity then bodyVelocity:Destroy() end
	if bodyGyro then bodyGyro:Destroy() end

	local character = player.Character
	if character then
		local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid then
			humanoid.PlatformStand = false
		end
	end
end

-- WalkSpeed Loop (Keeps WalkSpeed set continuously)
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	local character = player.Character
	if character then
		local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid and not flying then
			humanoid.WalkSpeed = walkSpeedValue
		end
	end
end)

-- RenderStepped Fly Movement Loop (Works with WASD & Mobile Joystick)
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	if flying and player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
		local root = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart
		local humanoid = player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

		bodyGyro.CFrame = camera.CFrame

		local moveDir = humanoid and humanoid.MoveDirection or Vector3.zero
		if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then
			bodyVelocity.Velocity = camera.CFrame.LookVector * (moveDir.Magnitude * speed)
		else
			bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.zero
		end
	end
end)

-- Rayfield Tab & Elements
local MainTab = Window:CreateTab("Main Controls", 4483362458)

local FlyToggle = MainTab:CreateToggle({
   Name = "Enable Fly",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Flag = "FlyToggle",
   Callback = function(Value)
      if Value then
         startFlying()
      else
         stopFlying()
      end
   end,
})

local SpeedSlider = MainTab:CreateSlider({
   Name = "Fly Speed",
   Range = {10, 300},
   Increment = 5,
   Suffix = "Speed",
   CurrentValue = 50,
   Flag = "SpeedSlider",
   Callback = function(Value)
      speed = Value
   end,
})

local WalkSpeedSlider = MainTab:CreateSlider({
   Name = "WalkSpeed",
   Range = {16, 250},
   Increment = 1,
   Suffix = "Speed",
   CurrentValue = 16,
   Flag = "WalkSpeedSlider",
   Callback = function(Value)
      walkSpeedValue = Value
      local character = player.Character
      if character then
         local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
         if humanoid then
            humanoid.WalkSpeed = Value
         end
      end
   end,
})
